paragraphs.text: Clippy (and :godmode:) in your DeepSeek Harness GUI
# Clippy Companion for DSH
**English** · Русский

A draggable companion that lives inside the DeepSeek Harness chat area, with
switchable sprite packs

. Two packs ship in the box: **Clippy** (OpenClippy
sprites) and **Doomguy** (DOOM II status-bar fac

es, meme faces included). The
drag area is measured from the conversation column itself, so the comp

anion
stays out of the sidebar and the presented-files panel and follows layout
changes (sidebar col
lapse, right panel, window resize, composer growth).
| Clippy | Doomguy |
## Features

- **Draggable.** Grab the companion and move it anywhere inside the chat column.
The position is cla

mped to that column and saved in `localStorage`, so it
survives reloads and adapts to a resized wind

ow.
- **Presets.** Right-click the companion (or long-press on touch) to switch
between packs, or us

e **Settings → General → Companion**. The choice is
remembered.
- **Per-preset voice.** Idle loops,

greetings, reactions and the random lines
all come from the pack's `preset.json`, including its own

set of comments.
- **Context damage.** The DOOM pack reads the live context pressure from the
token

meter and picks a beaten-up variant of the current face once the window
fills: healthy below 35%, wo

unded from 35%, badly hurt from 65%. When no
bloodied variant exists the healthy frame stays.
- **Ag

ent-aware.** During a turn the companion reflects thinking, the active
tool (editing, reading, shell

, or a generic tool), tool success or failure, a
pending decision, a message queued for the next tur

n (a raised-hand beat, no
bubble), a tool call that runs past ten seconds (`IdleFingerTap`, or `Angr

y`
for Doomguy), and the end of a turn. A speech bubble takes over briefly and
the activity animatio

n resumes afterwards.
- **Meme faces.** The pack also carries 22 high-res Reddit meme faces, scaled

down to the same 24×29 face size. Some have their own quote; otherwise one
shows up at random betwee

n idle animations.
- **Animated.** Idle loops, a greeting on load, and a reaction for every
comment,

all played at the frame durations declared by the sprite manifest.
- **Pokeable.** Click the compan

ion (or press Enter while it has focus) for a
short comment in a themed speech bubble. Keep poking a

nd it gets annoyed; a
double-click throws one of the pack's meme faces instead.
- **Naps.** After fi

ve quiet minutes it dozes off with a `Zzz` bubble, swapping
to the pack's sleep animation where one

exists. Any turn activity, click,
keypress or comment wakes it with the pack's wake-up animation.
-

**Keyboard accessible.** Focus the companion with Tab, move it with the arrow
keys (hold Shift for b

igger steps), speak with Enter or Space, open the preset

## Preset packs
Each pack is a directory under `assets/` with the following files:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`preset.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `scale` multiplies frame size and background position; `pixelated` switches
on nearest-neighbour r

endering for pixel art.
- `version` cache-busts the sprite and manifest URLs. Bump it whenever a pac

k's
images change, otherwise the browser keeps the old sheet for its cache
lifetime (`preset.json` i

tself is always fetched fresh).
- `greeting` plays once after load, `rest` is used for reduced motio

n and as a
fallback, `idle` is sampled at random between pauses, and `speech` maps a
locale key to a

reaction animation.
- Optional `memeIdle` (animation names) and `memeChance` (0–1) make an idle loo

p
occasionally show a random joke face instead of the regular idle set; the same
list feeds the doub

le-click meme burst.
- Optional `poke` (a list of `{ key, anim }`) answers a click, `pokeMad` answer

s
the third poke in a row, and `sleep` / `wake` name the dozing and waking
animations. Missing entri

es fall back to compatible animations from the pack.
- Damage variants are ordinary manifest animati

ons suffixed by tier:
`Angry`, `AngryHurt`, `AngryBad`. The client prefers the highest tier that
exi

sts for the requested base name.
- Add a pack by dropping its directory under `assets/` and adding o

ne row to
`PRESETS` in `client.js`. No Host change is needed: the asset route is a
prefix over the w

ETS` in `client.js`. No Host change is needed: the asset route is a
prefix over the whole directory.
## Rebuilding the DOOM pack
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The script keys the classic sheet, flood-fills the meme sheets' black
backgrounds, scales meme faces

into 24×29, packs every frame into 32×32 cells,
and writes `faces.png` plus the damage-tier manifes

t. Run it from the repository
root after changing any of the source sheets.
[该节后续省略]
## How it works

- `index.js` (Host) exposes `assets/` read-only on
`/clippy-companion/assets/<pack>/...`, with trave

rsal, extension and content
type checks.
- `client.js` (Client) registers a hidden probe in `convers

ation.input.dock`
that measures the chat column and forwards the `contextPressure` and `inbox`
proje

ctions plus the session's activity (running, active tool, latest tool
result, pending input, queued

messages), the companion in `shell.overlay`, and
a preference row in `settings.general.item`.
- Spri

te frames are drawn by shifting `background-position` on the single
sheet; timings come straight fro
m each pack's `sprite-data.json`.
